title: 第二十章
slug: 娇软妹宝随军后禁欲军官沦陷了
content_zh:
第(1/3)页

刚刚她在路上生怕自己耽误，反而害得苏清荔也跟着错过，于是一路小跑过来的。

现在看到马上轮到自己，王桂花脸上放松起来。

等上一位顾客走后，售货员头也不抬朝着人群喊，“下一位。”

“清荔，快去。”

王桂花催促她。

苏清荔刚要上前。

却见有人越过她，挤到货柜前大喊，“我要五块香皂，再加三瓶雪花膏和六条毛巾。”

眼看自己想要的东西被人买了个精光。

王桂花怒道：“你这人怎么插队呢？”

挡在她们面前的是个中年男人。

听到这话，他漫不经心掀了掀眼皮，“我在这里排队了半天，刚刚不过去个厕所的功夫，当然要在这里了。”

“嘿，”王桂花被他不要脸的模样气到了，当即撸起袖子，“胡扯！老娘我一直盯着队伍，你在没在我们前面，我能不知道？”

那男人上下打量她几下，冷哼一声，“刚刚你不也是插队进来的，有什么资格说我？”

“我跟她一块来的，这是她给我占的位置！”

“那我也是跟我婆娘过来的，这也是她给我留的位置。”

苏清荔可以确定这人是说谎。

刚才排她们前面的明明是个六十多岁的老太太。

就不可能跟男人是夫妻。

可前面人已经走远了。

她们没证据。

王桂花还想跟他掰扯，可身后人都等不及了。

“喂，我说你们到底在磨蹭什么？”

“就是，不买就滚出去。”

苏清荔见此，拉住王桂花。

“嫂子，别说了。”

王桂花也知道继续掰扯没啥意义。

只得吞下这口恶气。

“这下只能买支牙膏了。”王桂花垂头丧气地说。

苏清荔也有些烦躁。

毕竟她们等了足足三个小时。

就当两人郁闷时。

苏清荔却听耳边传来一道惊喜的声音。

“恩人，你来买东西啊？”

苏清荔听着这个声音，只觉莫名熟悉。

她朝前望去。

就见陈若笑眯眯的看着自己。

这不是那天她救的那个小男孩的母亲吗？

Page (1/3)

She was on the road just now, fearing that she would be delayed and that Su Qingli would miss her too, so she trotted all the way over.

Now that she saw that it was her turn soon, Wang Guihua's face relaxed.

After the last customer left, the salesperson shouted to the crowd without raising his head, "Next one."

"Qingli, go quickly."

Wang Guihua urged her.

Su Qingli was about to step forward.

But someone passed her and squeezed to the container and shouted, "I want five bars of soap, plus three bottles of cream and six towels."

Seeing that everything I wanted was bought out.

Wang Guihua said angrily: "Why do you jump in line?"

The person standing in front of them was a middle-aged man.

Hearing this, he casually raised his eyelids and said, "I've been queuing here for a long time. I just couldn't go to the toilet, so of course I have to be here."

"Hey," Wang Guihua was angry at his shameless appearance and immediately rolled up her sleeves, "Nonsense! I've been keeping an eye on the team. Do I know if you are in front of us or not?"

The man looked her up and down and snorted coldly, "You just jumped in line, so what qualifications do you have to criticize me?"

"I came with her, this is the place she occupied for me!"

"Then I came here with my mother-in-law, and this is the place she left for me."

Su Qingli was sure that this person was lying.

The person in front of them just now was obviously an old lady in her sixties.

It is impossible to be husband and wife with a man.

But the person in front has already gone far.

They have no evidence.

Wang Guihua still wanted to break up with him, but the people behind her couldn't wait any longer.

"Hey, what on earth are you dawdling about?"

"That's right, get out if you don't buy it."

Seeing this, Su Qingli grabbed Wang Guihua.

"Sister-in-law, stop talking."

Wang Guihua also knew that there was no point in continuing to argue.

I had to swallow this bad breath.

"Now I can only buy a toothpaste." Wang Guihua said dejectedly.

Su Qingli was also a little irritable.

After all, they had been waiting for three hours.

Just when the two of them were depressed.

Su Qingli heard a surprised voice in her ears.

"Benefactor, are you here to buy something?"

When Su Qingli heard this voice, she felt inexplicably familiar.

She looked forward.

He saw Chen Ruo looking at him with a smile.

Isn't this the mother of the little boy she saved that day?
